editor.imageWarningDescription: This instance hosts no images, and its security policy refuses remote ones. The markdown is kept in the content, so it still works wherever you paste it next — it simply shows nothing here.

setup.title: Welcome to shhh
setup.subtitle: Let's set up your instance before anything else.

account.title: Admin account
account.description: Create the first super admin account

errors.alreadyCompleted: This instance is already set up.
errors.generic: Something went wrong while setting up your instance.

create.subtitle: Encrypted in your browser. We never see the content or the key.
create.markdownHint: For a note or a document meant to be read. A secret meant to be copied exactly as typed should stay plain text.

errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 4 characters.
errors.generic: Something went wrong while creating the paste.
errors.noRecipients: Add at least one recipient, or turn off email sending.
errors.invalidRecipient: One of the recipients is not a valid email address.
errors.tooManyRecipients: This instance allows at most {max} recipients per paste.

result.title: Paste created
result.warning: This link contains the decryption key. It is never sent to the server and can't be recovered if lost.
result.emailSent: The link was emailed to your recipients.
result.emailFailed: The paste was created, but the email could not be sent.
result.emailFailedHint: Share the link below manually instead.
result.mailtoSubject: A secret was shared with you
result.mailtoBody: Open this link to read the secret. It contains the decryption key, so treat it as the secret itself.

anonymousDisabled.title: Anonymous pastes are disabled
anonymousDisabled.description: This instance only accepts pastes from signed-in accounts. Log in to create one.

create.shareByEmail: Also send the link by email
create.recipientsHint: One email is sent with everyone in blind copy, so recipients never see each other. The read counter is shared between them all. Sharing is only possible now — a paste cannot be emailed after it has been created.

read.burnWarningDescription: Once revealed, this counts against the paste's read limit.
read.burnWarningPassword: A wrong password costs nothing: the read is only spent once the password is right.

errors.notFound: This paste doesn't exist, has expired, or has already been read the maximum number of times.
errors.missingKeyDescription: The link is incomplete — the part after # is required to decrypt this paste.
errors.decryptFailed: Couldn't decrypt this paste. The password may be wrong, or the link is invalid.

login.title: Log in

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.backupCodeHint: Enter one of your backup codes.

login.noAccount: Don't have an account? Sign up

dashboard.title: Your pastes
dashboard.empty: You haven't created any pastes yet.

errors.generic: Something went wrong while saving settings.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: What this instance is holding, measured live against the quotas set in the instance settings.
storage.reclaimableHint: Unreadable already — expired, or read as many times as allowed. The hourly purge deletes them and frees this space.
storage.ceilingsSection: Largest paste against the per-paste limits
storage.ceilingsHint: How much of the per-paste ceiling the biggest stored payload actually uses. A near-empty bar means the limit is set far above what people send.
storage.databaseHint: What PostgreSQL actually occupies, indexes and compression included — always more than the sum of the payloads above, and the figure the volume runs out of.
storage.databaseUnavailable: The database did not report its size — some managed PostgreSQL providers deny this.

errors.generic: Something went wrong while loading the storage report.

storage.purgeConfirmTitle: Delete expired and fully read pastes?
storage.purgeConfirmDescription: This deletes {count} pastes that are already unreadable — expired, or read as many times as allowed — freeing {size}. Nothing readable is lost. This cannot be undone.

allowedIps.title: IP allowlist
allowedIps.description: IPs in this list bypass the anti-bot/anti-probe middleware entirely — useful for offices or admins behind a shared IP that would otherwise trip bot detection.
allowedIps.confirmDelete: Remove this IP from the allowlist?

errors.generic: Something went wrong while adding this IP.

bannedIps.title: IP blacklist
bannedIps.description: IPs banned automatically by the anti-bot/anti-probe middleware (scanner-bait paths, untrusted bots), or manually below.

errors.generic: Something went wrong while banning this IP.

users.title: Accounts
users.adminScopeNotice: As an admin, you can remove plain user accounts. Only a super admin can change roles or act on other admins/super admins.

menu.label: Actions for {email}
menu.purgeReclaimable: Delete expired and fully read pastes ({count})

confirm.reclaimableTitle: Delete expired and fully read pastes?
confirm.reclaimableDescription: This deletes {count} pastes belonging to {email} that are already unreadable — expired, or read as many times as allowed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.allPastesTitle: Delete every paste of this account?
confirm.allPastesDescription: This deletes all {count} pastes belonging to {email}, including those still readable. The account itself is kept. This cannot be undone.
confirm.accountDescription: This deletes the account {email} and its {count} pastes. This cannot be undone.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: Invite someone to create an account. An invitation works even when public registration is closed.
invitations.confirmRevoke: Revoke this invitation? The link will stop working immediately.
invitations.mailDisabledHint: Invitations are delivered by email, so this instance cannot send them. Set MAIL_PROVIDER and restart to enable them.
invitations.deliveryFailed: The invitation was created but the email could not be sent
invitations.deliveryFailedHint: Revoke it and try again once the mail provider works.

legal.title: Legal pages
legal.description: Publish a privacy policy, terms of use or legal notice. A document is linked in the footer as soon as it exists in one language; nothing is shown while none does.
legal.confirmTemplate: Replace what you have written with the shipped template?
legal.confirmDelete: Remove this document? The page and its footer link disappear.
legal.hint: The template is a starting point, not legal advice: read every paragraph and fill in the placeholders before publishing.

template.title: Fill in the template
template.description: One form for every language. Leave a field empty to keep its placeholder and come back to it later.
template.languagesHint: The values are the same in every language. Durations and sentences are written per language; everything else is inserted as you typed it. Each language is still saved on its own tab.
template.includeHint: Turn off to leave this information out

legal.placeholder: Markdown. Headings, lists, links and tables — no HTML, no components.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.scanInstructions: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, etc.).
twoFactor.backupCodesWarning: Each code can be used once to log in if you lose access to your authenticator app. They are only shown once.
twoFactor.confirmCode: Enter the code from your app to confirm
twoFactor.requiredDescription: This instance requires every account to use two-factor authentication. Set it up below to regain access to the rest of the app.
twoFactor.lockedByInstance: This instance requires two-factor authentication, so it cannot be turned off.
twoFactor.regeneratedWarning: These replace your previous backup codes, which no longer work. Save them now — they are shown only once.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.warningHint: Your account, all your pastes and their files are permanently deleted. Links you have already shared stop working immediately.
delete.confirmationLabel: Type your email address to confirm
delete.confirm: Permanently delete your account and all your pastes? This cannot be undone.
delete.superAdminTitle: The super admin account cannot be deleted
delete.superAdminHint: It is a system account. Transfer the super admin role to somebody else first, then delete this account.

email.hint: confirmation is sent to your current address
email.requestedHint: Check your current inbox and follow the link. Your address stays unchanged until you do.

register.title: Create your account
register.name: Name
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
register.closedHint: This instance does not accept public sign-ups. You need an invitation from an administrator.
register.invalidInvitation: This invitation link is not valid
register.invalidInvitationHint: It may have expired, been revoked, or already been used. Ask an administrator for a new one.
register.invitedHint: This account will be created for {email}.

seo.title: shhh — share a secret that expires
seo.description: A self-hostable, zero-knowledge pastebin. The server stores ciphertext and nothing else: the key lives in the URL fragment and never reaches it.

legal.otherLanguage: This instance publishes this document in another language only.
legal.notFound: This instance publishes no such document.
legal.seoDescription: How this instance handles your data.
